questions.question: A man in the crowd asked Jesus to make his brother share an inheritance. Jesus agreed to settle it. True or false?
Jesus told a crowd to watch out and guard themselves against every form of what?
In Jesus' story of a rich man with a huge harvest, what did the man plan to do with his grain?

answers.text: Tear down his barns and build bigger ones
Sell all of it before it could spoil
Give the extra away to his neighbors

questions.question: In Jesus' story of a rich man with a huge harvest, what did God say would happen to him that night?

answers.text: His life would be required of him
His barns would be burned with fire
His grain would be taken by thieves
